name: Nurokind OD Tablet 20'S
introduction:
Introduction About NUROKIND OD TABLET

NUROKIND OD TABLET contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. NUROKIND OD TABLET is used to manage peripheral neuropathies (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms) and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder that occurs due to abnormal production of red blood cells) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

NUROKIND OD TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines. It is also not recommended for use in patients with Leber’s disease (an inherited form of vision loss).

Before taking NUROKIND OD TABLET, inform your doctor if you are in an occupation of handling mercury and/or have kidney problems (such as renal failure) or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

NUROKIND OD TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NUROKIND OD TABLET are weakness, headache, back pain, muscle pain, indigestion, nausea, and/or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Manage peripheral neuropathies
Manage megaloblastic anaemia (caused by vitamin B12 deficiency) in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of NUROKIND OD TABLET
Manage peripheral neuropathies
Manage megaloblastic anaemia (caused by vitamin B12 deficiency) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How NUROKIND OD TABLET Works

NUROKIND OD TABLET works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (a lipid-rich material that covers nerve fibers), which helps in protecting the nerve fibers and thereby providing relief from painful diabetic neuropathy in affected individuals. It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anemia in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use NUROKIND OD TABLET

Tablet:

Take NUROKIND OD TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Oral Disintegrating Tablet:

Take NUROKIND OD TABLET as advised by your physician. Place NUROKIND OD TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Sublingual Tablet:

Take NUROKIND OD TABLET as advised by your physician. Place NUROKIND OD TABLET under the tongue till it dissolves. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.
sideEffects: Weakness, headache, back pain, generalized pain, muscle pain

name: MECONEURON OD 1500mcg Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About MECONEURON OD 1500MCG TABLET

MecoNeuron OD Tablet is a vitamin supplement which is used to manage or manage vitamin B12 deficiency in patients with neuropathy (nerve damage) due to diabetes or other causes. It contains methylcobalamin as an active ingredient which helps regulate vital body functions like cell multiplication, blood formation and protein synthesis.

Methylcobalamin works by taking part in the production of myelin (a compound which covers and protects nerve fibres). It also helps to revive the damaged neuron. It participates in the inhibitory pain pathways, thus helping in relieving nerve pain.

Always take MecoNeuron OD Tablet as advised by the physician. It is not recommended in patients having optic atrophy (a genetic eye condition), ongoing infection, low iron levels, blood in urine, and polycythaemia (a bone disease). Consult your doctor before taking MecoNeuron OD Tablet during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

name: Hosit Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About HOSIT TABLET

Hosit Tablet is a dietary supplement used to provide vitamins to people who do not have enough of these for good health. It contains methylcobalamin, pyridoxine hydrochloride and folic acid as active ingredients that help improve these levels.

Folic acid provides finished folate which the body can immediately use without any kind of metabolism. Methylcobalamin is important for the synthesis of DNA and helps manage neural tube defects. Pyridoxine helps in formation of red blood cells and also reduces morning sickness during pregnancy.

Always take Hosit Tablet as advised by your physician. Inform your doctor if you have certain blood disorders (Ex. pernicious anemia, other anaemias), or if you are using marijuana. Limit alcohol intake and do not drive, use machinery, or do anything that needs alertness until you can do it safely.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of HOSIT TABLET

Hosit Tablet may cause nausea, stomach upset, diarrhea, drowsiness, flushing, and numbness or tingling in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while taking it.

name: PIRACITRUM 800 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET

PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.   

Before taking PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.  

PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.    

PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.  

The common side effects of taking PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET are restlessness, nervousness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET
Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
mechanismOfAction:
How PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET Works

PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) which improves membrane stability and fluidity in brain thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors resulting in controlled movements.
usageDetails:
How to use PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET

Take PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET
Common
Restlessness, nervousness
Weight increase
Uncommon
Depression
Sleepiness
Weakness

warnings.details: PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Use contraception to avoid becoming pregnant. Consult your doctor before taking PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET.
PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding woman unless advised by the doctor as it is passed through the breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness and shakiness.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET.

PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Your doctor may adjust the dose based on functioning of the kidney. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not take PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET if you are allergic to Piracetam or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have huntington’s disease (also known as huntington’s chorea)
Have ever experienced a brain haemorrhage

Before taking PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have ever had any kind of bleeding problem

Use in pediatrics:

PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking PIRACITRUM 800 TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About GLA 120MG CAPSULE

GLA-120 Capsule is a nutritional supplement used to provide nutrition in conditions like eczema, arthritis, high blood pressure, asthma or nerve pain due to diabetes. It contains gamma-linolenic acid (GLA) as an active ingredient that shows anti-inflammatory action.

GLA is an omega-6 fatty acid found everywhere in the body. The body can convert GLA to substances that reduce inflammation and cell growth, and it helps with the function of all cells.

Take GLA-120 Capsule exactly as advised by your doctor. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, have bleeding disorders, or have any scheduled surgery.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of GLA 120MG CAPSULE

GLA-120 Capsule may cause soft stools, diarrhea, belching, and gas in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such effects while taking it.

Introduction About REJUNEX CAPSULE

Rejunex Capsule is a health supplement which helps to improve nerve cell function and vitamin B12 deficiencies. It contains Alpha Lipoic Acid, and Mecobalamin as main ingredients.

Alpha lipoic acid is a powerful antioxidant which protects the cell damage from free radicals. Methylcobalamin is necessary for the function of nerves, brain and production of red blood cells.

Always take Rejunex Capsule as advised by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take Rejunex Capsule if you are allergic to any of its components. Inform your doctor on all the medicines you use, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, as well as herbal supplements.

name: Benfomet Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BENFOMET PLUS TABLET

BENFOMET PLUS TABLET is a combination of Alpha lipoic acid, Methylcobalamin, Benfotiamine, Pyridoxine which belongs to the group of medicines called Nutritional supplements and Vitamins respectively. It is used to manage diabetic neuropathy and helps to manage blood sugar levels.

Diabetic neuropathy is a type of nerve damage occurring because of increased blood sugar levels which mainly occurs in feet and legs. Symptoms includes sharp pain, muscle weakness, severe sensitivity to touch, numbness, serious cases ulcers, infections, bone, and joint damages. Your doctor will ask you to monitor blood sugar levels regularly while taking management with BENFOMET PLUS TABLET.

It is not recommended for use in patients who are pregnant, breastfeeding, and allergic to any of its components. BENFOMET PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Before taking BENFOMET PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver disease, thyroid disease, severe diabetes, thiamine deficiency. The most common side effects of taking BENFOMET PLUS TABLET involves nausea, vomiting, skin rashes, loss of appetite with fear of weight gaining (anorexia), loose motions. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen or persists for a long duration.
uses: Used to manage diabetic peripheral neuropathy
usesDetails:
Uses Of BENFOMET PLUS TABLET
Used to manage diabetic peripheral neuropathy
mechanismOfAction:
How BENFOMET PLUS TABLET Works

BENFOMET PLUS TABLET is a combination of Alpha lipoic acid, Benfotiamine, Methylcobalamin and Pyridoxine. Alpha-lipoic acid easily enters the brain and the peripheral nerves and penetrates all parts of nerve cells to neutralise free radicals and stop the nerve tissue from ageing too quickly or degenerating chronically. Methylcobalamin improves the metabolism and antioxidant capability of brain and vascular endothelial cells to manage peripheral neuropathy. Pyridoxine helps to protect nerves from further damage, restores its structural and functional integrity and causes a recovery of function. Benfotiamine plays a role in glucose metabolism (conversion of glucose to energy) and helps to reduce blood sugar levels.
usageDetails:
How to use BENFOMET PLUS TABLET

Take BENFOMET PLUS TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration of BENFOMET PLUS TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NUROCOT 500MG TABLET

NUROCOT 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. NUROCOT 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

NUROCOT 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

NUROCOT 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking NUROCOT 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

NUROCOT 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NUROCOT 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How NUROCOT 500MG TABLET Works

NUROCOT 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use NUROCOT 500MG TABLET

Tablet:

Take NUROCOT 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take NUROCOT 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place NUROCOT 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Citicon P 500/800mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET

CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET Works

CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET

Take CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Therefore, inform your doctor before taking CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of childbearing age must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET.
CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience drowsiness or shakiness after taking CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET.

CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or ever had any severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET if you are allergic to Citicoline or Piracetam.

Others

CITICON P 500/800MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have a previous history of bleeding in the brain
Have Huntington Disease (a rare genetic disease that causes degeneration of nerve cells)
Have prolonged bleeding within the skull (intracranial hemorrhage)
Have trimethylaminuria (fishy odor in the urine)
Have Parkinson’s disease
Have a previous history of depression

introduction:
Introduction About CITIMET 500MG TABLET

CITIMET 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITIMET 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

CITIMET 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

CITIMET 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking CITIMET 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

CITIMET 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CITIMET 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITIMET 500MG TABLET Works

CITIMET 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take CITIMET 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place CITIMET 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MECONERV 1500MG TABLET

MECONERV 1500MG TABLET contains Mecobalamin which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. MECONERV 1500MG TABLET is used to manage peripheral neuropathies (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder that occurs due to abnormal production of red blood cells) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

MECONERV 1500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Mecobalamin, and/or other B12 containing medicines. It also not recommended for use in patients with Leber’s disease (inherited form of vision loss).

Before taking MECONERV 1500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are in an occupation of handling mercury, and/or have kidney problems (such as renal failure)/liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

MECONERV 1500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking MECONERV 1500MG TABLET are weakness, headache, back pain, muscle pain, indigestion, nausea, and/or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Manage peripheral neuropathies
Manage megaloblastic anaemia (caused by vitamin B12 deficiency) in affected individuals

Manage peripheral neuropathies
Manage megaloblastic anaemia (caused by vitamin B12 deficiency) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How MECONERV 1500MG TABLET Works

MECONERV 1500MG TABLET works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (lipid rich material that covers nerve fibres) which helps in protecting the nerve fibres and thereby providing relief from painful diabetic neuropathy in affected individuals.   It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anaemia in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET

MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET Works

MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET

Take MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MEGACHOLIN PLUS TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About PIRAMENT SYRUP

PIRAMENT SYRUP contains Piracetam, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm that may be caused by a disturbance in the brain and nervous system.

Before taking PIRAMENT SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.

PIRAMENT SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

PIRAMENT SYRUP is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with impaired renal function.

The common side effects of taking PIRAMENT SYRUP are restlessness, nervousness, and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How PIRAMENT SYRUP Works

PIRAMENT SYRUP is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA), which improves membrane stability and fluidity in the brain, thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors, resulting in controlled movements.

introduction:
Introduction About REJUNEX INJECTION

REJUNEX INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. REJUNEX INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

REJUNEX INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

REJUNEX INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving REJUNEX INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

REJUNEX INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving REJUNEX INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How REJUNEX INJECTION Works

REJUNEX INJECTION works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (a lipid-rich material that covers nerve fibers), which helps in protecting the nerve fibers and thereby providing relief from diabetic and peripheral neuropathy, sciatica pain, and back pain in affected individuals. It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anaemia in affected individuals.

REJUNEX INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Meconerv Z Syrup 200ml
introduction:
Introduction About MECONERV Z SYRUP

MECONERV Z SYRUP is a combination of Biotin, Lysine, Methylcobalamin, Niacinamide, Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol), and Zinc Gluconate which belongs to the group of medicines called Nutritional Supplements. It is used to manage peripheral neuropathy.

Peripheral neuropathy is a condition that occurs due to damage to the nerves outside the brain and the spinal cord. It is characterised by symptoms such as pain, a pins-and-needles sensation, numbness, and weakness.

Methylcobalamin is a form of Vitamin B12 that is essential for growth, cell multiplication, blood cell synthesis, and the synthesis of various nerve components with profound neurological effects. Niacinamide (vitamin B3) is a weak anticancer agent, an antioxidant, and a calcium modulator. It improves energy status and inhibits cell death in oxygen-deficient tissues.

MECONERV Z SYRUP is not recommended for use if you are allergic to biotin, lysine, methylcobalamin, niacinamide, vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol), or zinc gluconate. In patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease or chronic kidney disease, MECONERV Z SYRUP should be used with caution.

In pregnant and breastfeeding women, MECONERV Z SYRUP should be used with caution. It should be used with caution in children (below 4 years) and elderly patients (above 70 years).  Consult your doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How MECONERV Z SYRUP Works

Methylcobalamin is a form of Vitamin B12 that is essential for growth, cell multiplication, blood cell synthesis, and the synthesis of various nerve components with profound neurological effects. Niacinamide (vitamin B3) is a weak anticancer agent, an antioxidant, and a calcium modulator. It improves energy status and inhibits cell death in oxygen-deficient tissues.

Biotin is necessary for the proper functioning of enzymes that are required for various metabolic functions, including the synthesis of glucose, lipid synthesis, fatty acid biosynthesis, propionate metabolism, and the breakdown of complex amino acids.

Cholecalciferol (vitamin D) is a substance that promotes nerve growth and thus regulates neuronal growth and differentiation. Lysine protects the nerves by suppressing the agents that cause inflammation. Zinc gluconate regulates glucose metabolism in nerves and the spinal cord, thereby rejuvenating the health of peripheral nerves.

introduction:
Introduction About FLOCETAM 400MG TABLET

FLOCETAM 400MG TABLET contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.   

Before taking FLOCETAM 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.  

FLOCETAM 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.    

FLOCETAM 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.  

The common side effects of taking FLOCETAM 400MG TABLET are restlessness, nervousness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:

name: Rejunuron Forte Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION

REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Manage megaloblastic anaemia (caused by vitamin B12 deficiency)
Manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

mechanismOfAction:
How REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION Works

REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (a lipid-rich material that covers nerve fibers), which helps in protecting the nerve fibers and thereby providing relief from diabetic and peripheral neuropathy, sciatica pain, and back pain in affected individuals. It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anaemia in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION

REJUNURON FORTE INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NOOTROPIL SYRUP

NOOTROPIL SYRUP contains Piracetam, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm that may be caused by a disturbance in the brain and nervous system.

Before taking NOOTROPIL SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.

NOOTROPIL SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

NOOTROPIL SYRUP is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with impaired renal function.

The common side effects of taking NOOTROPIL SYRUP are restlessness, nervousness, and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOOTROPIL SYRUP
Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm)
mechanismOfAction:
How NOOTROPIL SYRUP Works

NOOTROPIL SYRUP is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA), which improves membrane stability and fluidity in the brain, thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors, resulting in controlled movements.
usageDetails:

Take NOOTROPIL SYRUP as advised by your physician. Shake the bottle well before each use. Measure the dose with the enclosed dosing cup. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NOOTROPIL SYRUP for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ELMECOB D TABLET

Elmecob D is a nutritional supplement used in adults and elderly to manage nutritional shortages in conditions like diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage occurring over time because of high sugar and fat content in the blood due to diabetes).

Elmecob D contains various vitamins and trace elements that helps to reactivate damaged nerve cells and overcome nutritional deficiencies.

Alpha lipoic acid is a potent antioxidant that manages neural complications. Vitamin D increases the level of nerve growth factor by stimulating its synthesis and managing its depletion. Pyridoxine is an essential nutrient which is needed for the synthesis of nerve chemicals.

Methylcobalamin and folic acid aid in the production of myelin (substance which covers and protect nerve fibres), thus restores the damaged nerve cell, improves the functional recovery of nerves, speed of nerve conduction, and cell multiplication.

Take Elmecob D exactly as advised by your doctor. Do not take Elmecob D if you have been told that you have increased calcium or vitamin D levels in blood or malabsorption syndrome.

Elmecob D should be cautiously used in patients with kidney or heart problems. Ask your doctor before giving Elmecob D to pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ELMECOB D TABLET

Elmecob D may cause nausea, vomiting, upset stomach and headache in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such effects while taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NERVUP INJECTION

NERVUP INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. NERVUP INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

NERVUP INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

NERVUP INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving NERVUP INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

NERVUP INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving NERVUP INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Manage megaloblastic anaemia (caused by vitamin B12 deficiency)
Manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

NERVUP INJECTION works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (a lipid-rich material that covers nerve fibers), which helps in protecting the nerve fibers and thereby providing relief from diabetic and peripheral neuropathy, sciatica pain, and back pain in affected individuals. It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anaemia in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About COGNOLIN TABLET

COGNOLIN TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. COGNOLIN TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

COGNOLIN TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

COGNOLIN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking COGNOLIN TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

COGNOLIN TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking COGNOLIN TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

COGNOLIN TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

name: Citinova 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CITINOVA 500MG TABLET

CITINOVA 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITINOVA 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

CITINOVA 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

CITINOVA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking CITINOVA 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

CITINOVA 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CITINOVA 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITINOVA 500MG TABLET Works

CITINOVA 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use CITINOVA 500MG TABLET

Tablet:

Take CITINOVA 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take CITINOVA 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place CITINOVA 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Nurite Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About NURITE INJECTION

NURITE INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. NURITE INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

NURITE INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

NURITE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving NURITE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

NURITE INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving NURITE INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Manage diabetic and peripheral neuropathies
Manage megaloblastic anaemia (caused by vitamin B12 deficiency)
Manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NURITE INJECTION
Manage diabetic and peripheral neuropathies
Manage megaloblastic anaemia (caused by vitamin B12 deficiency)
Manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.
mechanismOfAction:
How NURITE INJECTION Works

NURITE INJECTION works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (a lipid-rich material that covers nerve fibers), which helps in protecting the nerve fibers and thereby providing relief from diabetic and peripheral neuropathy, sciatica pain, and back pain in affected individuals. It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anaemia in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use NURITE INJECTION

NURITE INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: MEGACHOLIN RF 500mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET

MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET Works

MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

Tablet:

Take MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place MEGACHOLIN RF 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: PRE Aldonil 150mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET

PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET is a combination of Epalrestat and Pregabalin which belongs to the group of medicines called Aldose reductase inhibitors and Cyclic GABA analogues respectively. It is used in the management of diabetic neuropathy (nerve pain).

Diabetic neuropathy is a nerve damage occurring over time because of high sugar and fat levels in the blood due to diabetes. Symptoms depend on the type of neuropathy, such as pain and numbness in your feet or problems with the organ functions like that of your heart and bladder.

During management with PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET, your doctor will closely monitor if you have diabetic peripheral neuropathy with irreversible organic changes. Before taking PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of heart, liver or kidney disease, alcoholism or any drug abuse or dependence.

PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. The safety and effectiveness of PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET have not been established in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age), so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET are feeling generally unwell, headache, stomach pain, nausea, dizziness, dry mouth and constipation. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage diabetic nerve pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET
Manage diabetic nerve pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET Works

PRE ALDONIL 150MG TABLET reduces pain where epalrestat inhibits an enzyme (aldose reductase) which converts glucose into sorbitol. In diabetics, there is excess sorbitol production that gets deposited in nerves and other tissues, causing diabetic neuropathy. Thus, epalrestat delays sorbitol accumulation in nerves and other tissues to delay progression of diabetic neuropathy, and pregabalin provides neuroprotection, thus managing neuronal injury or damage.

introduction:
Introduction About PIRA GPC TABLET

PIRA GPC TABLET contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.   

Before taking PIRA GPC TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.  

PIRA GPC TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.    

PIRA GPC TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.  

The common side effects of taking PIRA GPC TABLET are restlessness, nervousness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of PIRA GPC TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How PIRA GPC TABLET Works

PIRA GPC TABLET is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) which improves membrane stability and fluidity in brain thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors resulting in controlled movements.

introduction:
Introduction About COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET

COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET Works

COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET

Take COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking COLIHENZ P 400MG TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

name: MENTOPLAST Syrup 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About MENTOPLAST SYRUP

MENTOPLAST SYRUP contains Piracetam, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm that may be caused by a disturbance in the brain and nervous system.

Before taking MENTOPLAST SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.

MENTOPLAST SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

MENTOPLAST SYRUP is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with impaired renal function.

The common side effects of taking MENTOPLAST SYRUP are restlessness, nervousness, and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MENTOPLAST SYRUP
Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm)
mechanismOfAction:
How MENTOPLAST SYRUP Works

MENTOPLAST SYRUP is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA), which improves membrane stability and fluidity in the brain, thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors, resulting in controlled movements.

introduction:
Introduction About CEHAM SYRUP

CEHAM SYRUP contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CEHAM SYRUP is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation and acute cerebral infraction.

CEHAM SYRUP is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) which is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition).

CEHAM SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking CEHAM SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery and/or have kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency)/liver problems (such as hepatic insufficiency).

CEHAM SYRUP should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CEHAM SYRUP are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation and acute cerebral infraction
Manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease and other cerebrovascular disease
Manage Parkinson’s disease
Helps in the acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction/ischemic stroke in affected individuals

mechanismOfAction:
How CEHAM SYRUP Works

CEHAM SYRUP works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET

COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

Acute stroke

mechanismOfAction:
How COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET Works

COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.

Take COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking COGNITAM PLUS 500/800 TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About REJUNURON PLUS TABLET

REJUNURON PLUS Tablet is a dietary supplement helps to manage neuropathic pain and diabetic nerve pain. It contains methyl cobalamin and Alpha lipoic acid as active ingredients.

Alpha Lipoic Acid is basically a fatty acid that occurs naturally in the body that has a protective effect on the nerves of the brain. It is an antioxidant that shields cells from oxidative stress and replenishes vitamin levels in the body. Methyl cobalamin are a form of vitamin B that assist the process production of myelin, which is responsible for rejuvenating the damaged nerves cell. It regulates how the body produces the protein and multiplies cells.

Take one REJUNURON PLUS Tablet twice daily or as advised by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing disease condition as a precaution.

name: Strocoz Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About STROCOZ PLUS TABLET

STROCOZ PLUS TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

STROCOZ PLUS TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking STROCOZ PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

STROCOZ PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with STROCOZ PLUS TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking STROCOZ PLUS TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.
uses: Acute stroke

Uses Of STROCOZ PLUS TABLET

Acute stroke
Memory loss associated with aging or brain injury
mechanismOfAction:
How STROCOZ PLUS TABLET Works

STROCOZ PLUS TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, STROCOZ PLUS TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use STROCOZ PLUS TABLET

Take STROCOZ PLUS TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking STROCOZ PLUS TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

name: ME PR Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ME PR CAPSULE

ME PR CAPSULE is used for the management of neuropathic pain. It is a combination of Pregabalin and Methylcobalamin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticonvulsants and Vitamin-B complex respectively. It consists of Methylcobalamin and Pregabalin where Methylcobalamin acts by rejuvenating the damaged neurons by improving the production of myelin and pregabalin acts by interfering with various pain signals travelling through the damaged nerves and the brain, thus leading to a significant pain relief in various neuropathic pain states.

Do not stop taking ME PR CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it could precipitate withdrawal symptoms such as headache, insomnia, nausea, pain, diarrhea, flu syndrome, anxiety, nervousness, depression, convulsion, excessive sweating, dizziness and physical dependence. ME PR CAPSULE has high potential to cause addiction and therefore caution should be exercised among patients who already has a history of substance abuse.

ME PR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor and in male patients who plan to father a child. The most common side effects are dizziness, sleepiness, headache, dry mouth, mood changes, fluid retention and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Have problems in glucose metabolism

Have folate deficiency
Have diabetes
Have epilepsy

name: Normabrain Injection 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About NORMABRAIN INJECTION

NORMABRAIN INJECTION contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.      

Before receiving NORMABRAIN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease, liver problems, gastrointestinal ulcer, history of cerebral hemorrhage, severe bleeding and are undergoing any major surgery including dental surgery.   

NORMABRAIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.  

NORMABRAIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The common side effects of receiving NORMABRAIN INJECTION are abnormal movements, nervousness and weight gain. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NORMABRAIN INJECTION
Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
mechanismOfAction:
How NORMABRAIN INJECTION Works

NORMABRAIN INJECTION is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) which improves membrane stability and fluidity in brain thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors resulting in controlled movements.
usageDetails:
How to use NORMABRAIN INJECTION

NORMABRAIN INJECTION should be only given by a doctor or a nurse. It should be given either intravenously (in the vein) or intramuscularly (in the muscle). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NORMABRAIN INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of NORMABRAIN INJECTION
Common
Nervousness
Abnormal movements (hyperkinesia)
Weight gain
Uncommon
Depression
Somnolence (excessive sleepiness)
Weakness (asthenia)

warnings.details: NORMABRAIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.
NORMABRAIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding woman as it is passes through breastmilk. Discuss the risks and benefits with your doctor before receiving this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving NORMABRAIN INJECTION.

NORMABRAIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with renal insufficiency. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.
NORMABRAIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients having liver impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.
Do not receive NORMABRAIN INJECTION if you are allergic to Piracetam, other pyrrolidone derivatives (such as levetiracetam) or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

NORMABRAIN INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have huntington’s disease (also known as huntington’s chorea)
Have ever experienced a brain haemorrhage 

Before receiving NORMABRAIN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe haemorrhage
Gastrointestinal ulcer (due to risk of bleeding)
Underlying disorders of haemostasis (process to manage and stop bleeding)
History of cerebral hemorrhage
Are undergoing major surgery including dental surgery

Use in pediatrics:

NORMABRAIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in children below 16 years of age. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.  

Use in geriatrics:

NORMABRAIN INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor may adjust the dose based on evaluation of functioning of the kidney. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About MYELOGEN PG 75MG TABLET

MYELOGEN PG 75MG TABLET is a combination of Folic Acid, Mecobalamin (Methylcobalamin), Pyridoxine, and Pregabalin which belongs to the group of medicines called Group B vitamins and Anticonvulsants respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful diabetic neuropathy.

Diabetic neuropathy is a condition that occurs due to high blood sugar levels in which nerves get weakened and damaged throughout the body, but more often in the legs and feet. It is characterized by symptoms such as tingling sensations, numbness, pain, weakness, cramps, and extreme sensitivity to touch in the affected area.

Do not take MYELOGEN PG 75MG TABLET if you are allergic to folic acid, mecobalamin (methylcobalamin), pyridoxine, or pregabalin. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, kidney impairment, congestive heart failure, or pre-existing ocular conditions (eye problems).

MYELOGEN PG 75MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children (aged 12 years or below) and elderly patients (aged 75 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The common side effects associated with the use of MYELOGEN PG 75MG TABLET are dizziness, sleepiness, ataxia (clumsy body movement), confusion, excessive weakness, abnormal thinking, and blurred vision. Contact your doctor or a nearby hospital if any of the conditions worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of MYELOGEN PG 75MG TABLET
Manage painful diabetic neuropathy
mechanismOfAction:
How MYELOGEN PG 75MG TABLET Works

MYELOGEN PG 75MG TABLET helps in managing nerve health, where pregabalin lowers the abnormal nerve conduction and pain conduction in the brain and spinal cord, thereby lowering the sensation of pain. Folic acid and pyridoxine play a vital role in the growth, differentiation, and regeneration of nerves and the central nervous system, whereas methylcobalamin helps in the synthesis of a compound called myelin that covers and protects nerve fibers, thereby reversing nerve damage and lowering nerve pain.
