introduction:
Introduction About PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE

PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE is a combination of Alpha lipoic acid, Methylcobalamin, Folic acid, Pregabalin, and Pyridoxine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antioxidants, Cyclic GABA analogues, and Vitamin B complexes, respectively. It is used in adults to manage painful diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage occurring over time because of high sugar and fat levels in the blood due to diabetes).

The symptoms depend on the type of neuropathy, such as pain and numbness in your feet or problems with organ functions like those of your heart and bladder. Avoid consuming alcohol during management with GBNKEYWORD.

PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (younger than 18 years), so consult your doctor before taking it. Before taking PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart, respiratory, or nervous system problems; diabetes; or a history of alcoholism or any drug abuse or dependence.

PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless necessary. The most common side effects of taking PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE are dizziness, drowsiness, headache, increased appetite, blurred vision, weight gain, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: Manage painful diabetic neuropathy in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE
Manage painful diabetic neuropathy in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE Works

PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE relieves nerve pain where alpha-lipoic acid reduces oxidative stress, which is considered a main pathophysiology of diabetic neuropathy development; folic acid (Vitamin B9) is found to improve the functional recovery of nerves, speed of nerve conduction, and cell multiplication; and methylcobalamin takes part in the production of myelin (a compound that covers and protects nerve fibers), thus restoring the damaged nerve cell. Pregabalin binds with high affinity to certain sites in the tissues of the central nervous system and acts as a growth factor for nerve cells, helping to regenerate the damaged nerve tissue, and pyridoxine acts as a coenzyme in a wide range of metabolic functions affecting protein, carbohydrate, and lipid utilization, like the breakdown of glycogen to glucose-1-phosphate and the synthesis of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA).
usageDetails:
How to use PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE

Take PREGADOC PLUS CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. introduction:
Introduction About NEUROCETAM INJECTION

NEUROCETAM INJECTION contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.      

Before receiving NEUROCETAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease, liver problems, gastrointestinal ulcer, history of cerebral hemorrhage, severe bleeding and are undergoing any major surgery including dental surgery.   

NEUROCETAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.  

NEUROCETAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The common side effects of receiving NEUROCETAM INJECTION are abnormal movements, nervousness and weight gain. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEUROCETAM INJECTION
Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
mechanismOfAction:
How NEUROCETAM INJECTION Works

NEUROCETAM INJECTION is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) which improves membrane stability and fluidity in brain thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors resulting in controlled movements.
usageDetails:
How to use NEUROCETAM INJECTION

NEUROCETAM INJECTION should be only given by a doctor or a nurse. It should be given either intravenously (in the vein) or intramuscularly (in the muscle). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NEUROCETAM INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

NEUROCETAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients having liver impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.
Do not receive NEUROCETAM INJECTION if you are allergic to Piracetam, other pyrrolidone derivatives (such as levetiracetam) or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Have huntington’s disease (also known as huntington’s chorea)
Have ever experienced a brain haemorrhage 

Before receiving NEUROCETAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe haemorrhage
Gastrointestinal ulcer (due to risk of bleeding)
Underlying disorders of haemostasis (process to manage and stop bleeding)

Are undergoing major surgery including dental surgery

Use in geriatrics:

NEUROCETAM INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor may adjust the dose based on evaluation of functioning of the kidney. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

name: CITICUS P Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CITICUS P TABLET

CITICUS P TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

CITICUS P TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking CITICUS P TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

CITICUS P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CITICUS P TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking CITICUS P TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITICUS P TABLET Works

CITICUS P TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, CITICUS P TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use CITICUS P TABLET

Take CITICUS P TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CITICUS P TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

name: Voltaneuron DN Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About VOLTANEURON DN TABLET

Voltaneuron DN Tablet  is a nutritional supplement used for various neuropathy conditions. It contains Benfotiamine, Alpha lipoic acid, Methylcobalamin, Pyridoxine and Inositol. Voltaneuron DN Tablet provides essential nutrients to the body.

Alpha Lipoic Acid is a powerful antioxidant that protects the neurons from oxidative stress. Inositol helps to reduce blood sugar levels and helps in healing the nerve damage. Benfotiamine increases transketolase activity, that in turn decreases the buildup of detrimental glucose metabolites that can lead to advanced glycation end products (AGE), which may lead to diabetic complications. It is useful in diabetic retinopathy. Methylcobalamin is an essential nutrient for neurons.

Take Voltaneuron DN Tablet as advised by the physician. It is not recommended if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. It is recommended to inform your doctor about all the medicines that you take, including prescription, over-the-counter medications and herbal supplements. It is recommended to inform your doctor about the current health conditions if you are suffering from any disease conditions.

name: Meconerv Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About MECONERV INJECTION

MECONERV INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. MECONERV INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

MECONERV INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

MECONERV INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving MECONERV INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

MECONERV INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving MECONERV INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

MECONERV INJECTION works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (a lipid-rich material that covers nerve fibers), which helps in protecting the nerve fibers and thereby providing relief from diabetic and peripheral neuropathy, sciatica pain, and back pain in affected individuals. It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anaemia in affected individuals.

MECONERV INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About COGNOLIN P TABLET

COGNOLIN P TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

COGNOLIN P TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking COGNOLIN P TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

COGNOLIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with COGNOLIN P TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking COGNOLIN P TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How COGNOLIN P TABLET Works

COGNOLIN P TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, COGNOLIN P TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use COGNOLIN P TABLET

Take COGNOLIN P TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking COGNOLIN P TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Therefore, inform your doctor before taking COGNOLIN P TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of childbearing age must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with COGNOLIN P TABLET.
COGNOLIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience drowsiness or shakiness after taking COGNOLIN P TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with COGNOLIN P TABLET.

COGNOLIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take COGNOLIN P TABLET if you are allergic to Citicoline or Piracetam.

Have a previous history of bleeding in the brain
Have Huntington Disease (a rare genetic disease that causes degeneration of nerve cells)
Have prolonged bleeding within the skull (intracranial hemorrhage)
Have trimethylaminuria (fishy odor in the urine)
Have Parkinson’s disease

introduction:
Introduction About CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION

CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION Works

CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

CITINOVA 250MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or into a muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PIRACITRUM SYRUP

PIRACITRUM SYRUP contains Piracetam, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm that may be caused by a disturbance in the brain and nervous system.

Before taking PIRACITRUM SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.

PIRACITRUM SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

PIRACITRUM SYRUP is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with impaired renal function.

The common side effects of taking PIRACITRUM SYRUP are restlessness, nervousness, and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About STORAX PR TABLET

STORAX PR TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

STORAX PR TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking STORAX PR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

STORAX PR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with STORAX PR TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking STORAX PR TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.
uses: Acute stroke

Acute stroke
Memory loss associated with aging or brain injury
mechanismOfAction:
How STORAX PR TABLET Works

STORAX PR TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, STORAX PR TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use STORAX PR TABLET

Take STORAX PR TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking STORAX PR TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

name: Strocit Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About STROCIT INJECTION

STROCIT INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. STROCIT INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

STROCIT INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

STROCIT INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving STROCIT INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

STROCIT INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

STROCIT INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving STROCIT INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

usesDetails:
Uses Of STROCIT INJECTION
Manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.
Manage Alzheimer’s disease and dementia (memory loss) due to Parkinson’s disease.
Helps in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How STROCIT INJECTION Works

STROCIT INJECTION works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use STROCIT INJECTION

STROCIT INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or into a muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Signs of shock (life threatening condition that occurs due to insufficient blood flow to the body) such as drop in blood pressure, distressed feeling of the chest, and/or shortness of breath
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of STROCIT INJECTION
Common
Diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain
Rash
Insomnia (sleeplessness)
Occurrence/intensification of numbness
Uncommon
Excitation, convulsions
General discomfort, anorexia (eating disorder)
Diplopia (double vision)
Blood pressure changes
Shock, shortness of breath
Distressed feeling of the chest
Rare

Stop receiving STROCIT INJECTION and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Signs of shock (life threatening condition that occurs due to insufficient blood flow to the body) such as drop in blood pressure, distressed feeling of the chest, and/or shortness of breath

warnings.details: STROCIT INJECTION should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. Inform your doctor immediately if you get pregnant while on management with STROCIT INJECTION. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

STROCIT INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary since it is not known whether the medicine passes through breast milk. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines until the full effect of STROCIT INJECTION is known.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving STROCIT INJECTION because it might the effect of the medicine.

STROCIT INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease such as renal impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
STROCIT INJECTION should be received with caution in patients with liver disorders. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not receive STROCIT INJECTION if you are allergic to Citicoline, and/or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

STROCIT INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Are hypertonic (muscle overactivity)
Suffer from persistent intracranial haemorrhages (persistent bleeding inside the brain)

Before receiving STROCIT INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a history of epilepsy/fits
Suffer from depression
Are scheduled for a surgery
Have trimethylaminuria (fish odour syndrome)

Use in Paediatrics:

STROCIT INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics:

STROCIT INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving STROCIT INJECTION.

name: Somazina Plus 400 Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

Memory loss associated with aging or brain injury
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET

Acute stroke
Memory loss associated with aging or brain injury
mechanismOfAction:
How SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET Works

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET

Take SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.
sideEffects: Back pain, shoulder pain, joint pain
Severe allergic reaction (such as skin rash, swelling of the face, eyelids, lips, tongue or throat which causes difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

Common

Dizziness
Difficulty in falling asleep

Skin rash
Back pain, shoulder pain, joint pain
Uncommon
Feeling sad or depressed
Tiredness, weakness
Rare

Stop taking SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reaction (such as skin rash, swelling of the face, eyelids, lips, tongue or throat which causes difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

warnings.details: SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET should be used in pregnancy only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Your doctor will evaluate the risks and benefits of the therapy and prescribes it to you accordingly. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of childbearing age must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET.
SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience drowsiness or shakiness after taking SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET.

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or ever had any severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to Citicoline or Piracetam.

Others

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have a previous history of bleeding in the brain
Have Huntington Disease (a rare genetic disease that causes degeneration of nerve cells)
Have prolonged bleeding within the skull (intracranial hemorrhage)
Have trimethylaminuria (fishy odor in the urine)
Have Parkinson’s disease
Have a previous history of depression

Before taking SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have any bleeding problems

Use in Pediatrics:

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

SOMAZINA PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NEUROKEM M CAPSULE

NEUROKEM M CAPSULE is used for the management of neuropathic pain. It is a combination of Pregabalin and Methylcobalamin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticonvulsants and Vitamin-B complex respectively. It consists of Methylcobalamin and Pregabalin where Methylcobalamin acts by rejuvenating the damaged neurons by improving the production of myelin and pregabalin acts by interfering with various pain signals travelling through the damaged nerves and the brain, thus leading to a significant pain relief in various neuropathic pain states.

Do not stop taking NEUROKEM M CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it could precipitate withdrawal symptoms such as headache, insomnia, nausea, pain, diarrhea, flu syndrome, anxiety, nervousness, depression, convulsion, excessive sweating, dizziness and physical dependence. NEUROKEM M CAPSULE has high potential to cause addiction and therefore caution should be exercised among patients who already has a history of substance abuse.

NEUROKEM M CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor and in male patients who plan to father a child. The most common side effects are dizziness, sleepiness, headache, dry mouth, mood changes, fluid retention and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage neuropathic pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEUROKEM M CAPSULE
Used to manage neuropathic pain

How NEUROKEM M CAPSULE Works

NEUROKEM M CAPSULE effectively alleviates the symptoms of various types of neuropathic pain, where Methylcobalamin acts by rejuvenating the damaged neurons by improving the production of myelin and Pregabalin acts by interfering with various pain signals travelling through the damaged nerves and the brain, thus leading to a significant pain relief in various neuropathic pain states.

Common side effects of NEUROKEM M CAPSULE:
Dizziness
Sleepiness
Headache
Common cold
Nausea, vomiting
Increased appetite

Dry mouth
Feeling excited or pleasurable)
Impaired balance or coordination

Tiredness
Blurred vision
Spinning sensation
Muscle cramps
Pain in limbs, joints or back

Stop taking NEUROKEM M CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat, neck and difficulty in breathing)
Symptoms of elevated creatine kinase (unexplained muscle pain, tenderness or weakness, accompanied by malaise or fever)

warnings.details: There is no proper information on the use of NEUROKEM M CAPSULE during pregnancy and therefore should be used only if the benefit to the mother clearly outweighs the potential risk to the fetus.
NEUROKEM M CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or sleepiness after taking this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NEUROKEM M CAPSULE, as it may cause impairment of motor skills and sedating effects of alcohol.
NEUROKEM M CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with impaired kidney function.
NEUROKEM M CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take NEUROKEM M CAPSULE if you are allergic to Pregabalin, Methylcobalamin or any other ingredients of this medicine.
NEUROKEM M CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with heart disease such as congestive heart failure.
NEUROKEM M CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data.

NEUROKEM M CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above), especially in patients with decreased renal function. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of kidney function are required in such patients.

Others

NEUROKEM M CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have Leber’s disease
Have problems in glucose metabolism

Before taking this medicine, inform your physician if you:

Have history of misuse or substance abuse
Have folate deficiency
Have diabetes
Have epilepsy
Have or at risk of encephalopathy

name: Moracetam 800mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MORACETAM 800MG TABLET

MORACETAM 800MG TABLET contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.   

Before taking MORACETAM 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.  

MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.    

MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.  

The common side effects of taking MORACETAM 800MG TABLET are restlessness, nervousness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MORACETAM 800MG TABLET
Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
mechanismOfAction:
How MORACETAM 800MG TABLET Works

MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) which improves membrane stability and fluidity in brain thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors resulting in controlled movements.
usageDetails:
How to use MORACETAM 800MG TABLET

Take MORACETAM 800MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MORACETAM 800MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Use contraception to avoid becoming pregnant. Consult your doctor before taking MORACETAM 800MG TABLET.
MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding woman unless advised by the doctor as it is passed through the breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness and shakiness.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MORACETAM 800MG TABLET.

MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Your doctor may adjust the dose based on functioning of the kidney. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not take MORACETAM 800MG TABLET if you are allergic to Piracetam or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have huntington’s disease (also known as huntington’s chorea)
Have ever experienced a brain haemorrhage

Before taking MORACETAM 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have ever had any kind of bleeding problem

Use in pediatrics:

MORACETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

MORACETAM 800MG TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking MORACETAM 800MG TABLET.

name: Edastar Injection 20ml
introduction:
Introduction About EDASTAR INJECTION

EDASTAR INJECTION contains Edaravone which belongs to group of medicines called Antioxidants. EDASTAR INJECTION is used to manage amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (nervous system disease that weakens muscles and impacts physical function) in affected individuals.

EDASTAR INJECTION is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Edaravone.

Before receiving EDASTAR INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have lung problems (such as asthma), kidney problems (such as impaired renal insufficiency), and/or liver problems (such as mild/moderate/severe hepatic insufficiency).

EDASTAR INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary since there is no adequate data to determine safety and efficacy of the medicine.

EDASTAR INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years) as there is no adequate data to determine the safety and efficacy of the medicine in children. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving EDASTAR INJECTION are confusion, gait disturbance, headache, dermatitis, eczema, and/or tinea infection (fungal infection of skin). Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of EDASTAR INJECTION
Manage amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How EDASTAR INJECTION Works

EDASTAR INJECTION works by relieving the effects of oxidative stress (condition that occurs due to imbalance of free radicals and antioxidants in the body during ageing process) which results in delayed nerve damage associated with the symptoms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis condition thus preserving the motor function and managing the associated symptoms of the condition in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use EDASTAR INJECTION

EDASTAR INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Signs of glycosuria (condition marked by excess sugar in urine) such as extreme hunger, accidental urination, nighttime urination
Signs of hypersensitivity reactions (immune mediated response to an allergen) such as red itchy welts, breathing problems, itching, swelling of lips/tongue/face, dizziness, wheezing, and/or fainting

Signs of sulfite allergic reactions such as asthma attack (in people with a history of asthma), red itchy welts, breathing problems, itching, swelling of lips/tongue/face, dizziness, wheezing, and/or fainting

EDASTAR INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary as there is no data to determine its safety and efficacy. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
EDASTAR INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems such as renal insufficiency. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
EDASTAR INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems such as mild/moderate/severe hepatic insufficiency. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Do not receive EDASTAR INJECTION if you are allergic to edaravone, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution in patients allergic to sulfites. Consult and inform your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics:

EDASTAR INJECTION should be received with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult and inform your doctor before receiving the medicine.

name: Citimac 250mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION

CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.
Manage Alzheimer’s disease and dementia (memory loss) due to Parkinson’s disease.
Helps in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION

mechanismOfAction:
How CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION Works

CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION

CITIMAC 250MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or into a muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Signs of shock (life threatening condition that occurs due to insufficient blood flow to the body) such as drop in blood pressure, distressed feeling of the chest, and/or shortness of breath

introduction:
Introduction About SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION

SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION Works

SOMAZINA 500MG INJECTION works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

name: ENCETAM 800mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ENCETAM 800MG TABLET

ENCETAM 800MG TABLET contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.   

Before taking ENCETAM 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.  

ENCETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.    

ENCETAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.  

The common side effects of taking ENCETAM 800MG TABLET are restlessness, nervousness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENCETAM 800MG TABLET
Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
mechanismOfAction:
How ENCETAM 800MG TABLET Works

ENCETAM 800MG TABLET is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) which improves membrane stability and fluidity in brain thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors resulting in controlled movements.
usageDetails:
How to use ENCETAM 800MG TABLET

Take ENCETAM 800MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ENCETAM 800MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RENERVE INJECTION

RENERVE INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. RENERVE INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

RENERVE INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

RENERVE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving RENERVE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

RENERVE INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving RENERVE INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION

NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.      

Before receiving NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease, liver problems, gastrointestinal ulcer, history of cerebral hemorrhage, severe bleeding and are undergoing any major surgery including dental surgery.   

NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.  

NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The common side effects of receiving NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION are abnormal movements, nervousness and weight gain. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
usesDetails:

Manage myoclonus (sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm)
mechanismOfAction:
How NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION Works

NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) which improves membrane stability and fluidity in brain thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors resulting in controlled movements.

How to use NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION

NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION should be only given by a doctor or a nurse. It should be given either intravenously (in the vein) or intramuscularly (in the muscle). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NOOTROPIL 200MG INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: CITIREST Syrup 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About CITIREST SYRUP

CITIREST SYRUP contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITIREST SYRUP is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation and acute cerebral infraction.

CITIREST SYRUP is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) which is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition).

CITIREST SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking CITIREST SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery and/or have kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency)/liver problems (such as hepatic insufficiency).

CITIREST SYRUP should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CITIREST SYRUP are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITIREST SYRUP Works

CITIREST SYRUP works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

ANODINE 50MG CAPSULE is used to manage neuropathic pain, peripheral neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia syndrome, peripheral and central neuropathic pain. It contains Pregabalin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticonvulsants. It can also be used to manage certain forms of epilepsy (fits or seizures) when used in combination with other anti-epileptic medicines. It may also be effective in managing generalized anxiety disorders (severe anxiety that affects daily activities) when other medicines are not effective.

Before taking ANODINE 50MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have or had any lung, liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor before taking the medicine if you have diabetes, any other nerve or brain disorders or if you have a history of drug abuse. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking the medicine as it may make you feel dizzier which can eventually lead to an increased risk of injuries, falls or accidents. Do not take the medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding mother. Women of childbearing age must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with the medicine.

ANODINE 50MG CAPSULE should be used with extreme caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) particularly in those who have kidney problems. It may alter the blood sugar levels, therefore regularly check your blood sugar levels as a precaution. The most common side are dizziness, drowsiness, headache, dry mouth, blurred vision and swelling of body parts. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ANODINE 50MG CAPSULE Works

ANODINE 50MG CAPSULE works by binding to the alpha2-delta subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels, which reduces the release of neurotransmitters and neuronal excitability. It acts as a specific analgesic for peripheral and central neuropathic pain by blocking the transmission of pain signals across the nervous system. It relieves anxiety by reducing the release of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that causes abnormal mood stimulation and anxiety.

introduction:
Introduction About CEACT 400 TABLET

CEACT 400 TABLET contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.   

Before taking CEACT 400 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.  

CEACT 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.    

CEACT 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.  

The common side effects of taking CEACT 400 TABLET are restlessness, nervousness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: Edavit 1.5mg Injection 20ml
introduction:
Introduction About EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION

EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION contains Edaravone which belongs to group of medicines called Antioxidants. EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION is used to manage amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (nervous system disease that weakens muscles and impacts physical function) in affected individuals.

EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Edaravone.

Before receiving EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have lung problems (such as asthma), kidney problems (such as impaired renal insufficiency), and/or liver problems (such as mild/moderate/severe hepatic insufficiency).

EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary since there is no adequate data to determine safety and efficacy of the medicine.

EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years) as there is no adequate data to determine the safety and efficacy of the medicine in children. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION are confusion, gait disturbance, headache, dermatitis, eczema, and/or tinea infection (fungal infection of skin). Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION
Manage amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION Works

EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION works by relieving the effects of oxidative stress (condition that occurs due to imbalance of free radicals and antioxidants in the body during ageing process) which results in delayed nerve damage associated with the symptoms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis condition thus preserving the motor function and managing the associated symptoms of the condition in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION

EDAVIT 1.5MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CITISTAR PM TABLET

CITISTAR PM TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

CITISTAR PM TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking CITISTAR PM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

CITISTAR PM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CITISTAR PM TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking CITISTAR PM TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITISTAR PM TABLET Works

CITISTAR PM TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, CITISTAR PM TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use CITISTAR PM TABLET

Take CITISTAR PM TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CITISTAR PM TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About PREXARON

PREXARON contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. PREXARON is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation and acute cerebral infraction.

PREXARON is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) which is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition).

PREXARON is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking PREXARON, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery and/or have kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency)/liver problems (such as hepatic insufficiency).

PREXARON should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking PREXARON are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREXARON Works

PREXARON works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION

CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION Works

CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

CITIZAC 1000MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or into a muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About PIRAHENZ 800MG TABLET

PIRAHENZ 800MG TABLET contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.   

Before taking PIRAHENZ 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.  

PIRAHENZ 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.    

PIRAHENZ 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.  

The common side effects of taking PIRAHENZ 800MG TABLET are restlessness, nervousness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET

CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET Works

CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CITELEC P 500/800MG TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Introduction About COGNITAM SYRUP

COGNITAM SYRUP contains Piracetam, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm that may be caused by a disturbance in the brain and nervous system.

Before taking COGNITAM SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.

COGNITAM SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

COGNITAM SYRUP is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with impaired renal function.

The common side effects of taking COGNITAM SYRUP are restlessness, nervousness, and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NURODAY 500 INJECTION

NURODAY 500 INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. NURODAY 500 INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

NURODAY 500 INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

NURODAY 500 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving NURODAY 500 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

NURODAY 500 INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving NURODAY 500 INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How NURODAY 500 INJECTION Works

NURODAY 500 INJECTION works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (a lipid-rich material that covers nerve fibers), which helps in protecting the nerve fibers and thereby providing relief from diabetic and peripheral neuropathy, sciatica pain, and back pain in affected individuals. It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anaemia in affected individuals.

NURODAY 500 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP

NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP.

The most common side effects of taking NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.
