mechanismOfAction:
How NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP Works

NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, NEUCITI PLUS SYRUP repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.

introduction:
Introduction About PREXARON 500MG TABLET

PREXARON 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. PREXARON 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

PREXARON 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

PREXARON 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking PREXARON 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

PREXARON 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking PREXARON 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREXARON 500MG TABLET Works

PREXARON 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take PREXARON 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place PREXARON 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: NUROCOT P Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About NUROCOT P TABLET

NUROCOT P TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

NUROCOT P TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking NUROCOT P TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

NUROCOT P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NUROCOT P TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking NUROCOT P TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How NUROCOT P TABLET Works

NUROCOT P TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, NUROCOT P TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.

Take NUROCOT P TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking NUROCOT P TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About STROZINA INJECTION

STROZINA INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. STROZINA INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

STROZINA INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

STROZINA INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving STROZINA INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

STROZINA INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

STROZINA INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving STROZINA INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About CEREHENZ 60 INJECTION

CEREHENZ 60 INJECTION contains Cerebroprotein Hydrolysate which belongs to group of medicines called Neurotrophic agents. It is used to manage cranial injury, aprosexia (inability to concentrate) in dementia, cerebrovascular disease that includes stroke, and Alzheimer's disease.

A cranial injury is a head injury causing trauma to the scalp, skull, or brain. It is characterised by symptoms such as leakage of blood outside the blood vessels, uncontrolled bleeding, skull fracture, brain injury, or swelling in the brain.

A stroke occurs when the blood supply to the brain or part of it is blocked. It is characterised by symptoms such as troubled speech, numbness in the body, visual disturbances, headaches, and troubled waking.

Dementia is a group of symptoms such as loss of memory and thinking/reasoning abilities. Alzheimer’s disease is a disorder that causes progressive degeneration of brain cells, resulting in brain shrinkage. It is characterised by dementia, social withdrawal, and wandering.

CEREHENZ 60 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe renal dysfunction, status epilepticus (a life-threatening neurological disorder), or major epilepsia (a seizure that causes loss of consciousness and violent muscle contractions).

CEREHENZ 60 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with epilepsy (fits or seizures) and or allergic diathesis (condition causing predisposition to develop group of allergies such as hay fever, allergic rhinitis, bronchial asthma, or atopic dermatitis).

CEREHENZ 60 INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding females only if it is clearly needed. CEREHENZ 60 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The common side effects associated with the use of CEREHENZ 60 INJECTION are headache, nausea, vertigo (sensation of spinning), increased sweating, agitation, fever, and hallucinations. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CITISTAR 4 INJECTION

CITISTAR 4 INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITISTAR 4 INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

CITISTAR 4 INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

CITISTAR 4 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving CITISTAR 4 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

CITISTAR 4 INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

CITISTAR 4 INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving CITISTAR 4 INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITISTAR 4 INJECTION Works

CITISTAR 4 INJECTION works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About PC 8 TABLET

PC 8 TABLET contains Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake or spasm that may be caused due to disturbance in the brain and nervous system.   

Before taking PC 8 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.  

PC 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless advised by the doctor.    

PC 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.  

The common side effects of taking PC 8 TABLET are restlessness, nervousness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

PC 8 TABLET is a derivative of the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) which improves membrane stability and fluidity in brain thereby restoring the neurotransmission via glutamatergic and cholinergic (ACh) receptors resulting in controlled movements.

Take PC 8 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of PC 8 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ENCETAM CT TABLET

ENCETAM CT TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

ENCETAM CT TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking ENCETAM CT TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

ENCETAM CT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with ENCETAM CT TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking ENCETAM CT TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.
uses: Acute stroke

mechanismOfAction:
How ENCETAM CT TABLET Works

ENCETAM CT TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, ENCETAM CT TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.

How to use ENCETAM CT TABLET

Take ENCETAM CT TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENCETAM CT TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

name: TOKO 500 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TOKO 500 TABLET

TOKO 500 TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. TOKO 500 TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

TOKO 500 TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

TOKO 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking TOKO 500 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

TOKO 500 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking TOKO 500 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TOKO 500 TABLET Works

TOKO 500 TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

Take TOKO 500 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place TOKO 500 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CERECETAM SYRUP

CERECETAM SYRUP contains Piracetam, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Nootropics. It is used in the management of myoclonus of cortical origin in combination with other anti-myoclonic therapies. Myoclonus is a sudden, involuntary muscle jerk, shake, or spasm that may be caused by a disturbance in the brain and nervous system.

Before taking CERECETAM SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have severe kidney disease and liver problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine.

CERECETAM SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

CERECETAM SYRUP is not recommended for use in children (below 16 years of age). It should be taken with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with impaired renal function.

The common side effects of taking CERECETAM SYRUP are restlessness, nervousness, and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVA M 75MG CAPSULE

NOVA M 75MG CAPSULE is used for the management of neuropathic pain. It is a combination of Pregabalin and Methylcobalamin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticonvulsants and Vitamin-B complex respectively. It consists of Methylcobalamin and Pregabalin where Methylcobalamin acts by rejuvenating the damaged neurons by improving the production of myelin and pregabalin acts by interfering with various pain signals travelling through the damaged nerves and the brain, thus leading to a significant pain relief in various neuropathic pain states.

Do not stop taking NOVA M 75MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it could precipitate withdrawal symptoms such as headache, insomnia, nausea, pain, diarrhea, flu syndrome, anxiety, nervousness, depression, convulsion, excessive sweating, dizziness and physical dependence. NOVA M 75MG CAPSULE has high potential to cause addiction and therefore caution should be exercised among patients who already has a history of substance abuse.

NOVA M 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor and in male patients who plan to father a child. The most common side effects are dizziness, sleepiness, headache, dry mouth, mood changes, fluid retention and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

NOVA M 75MG CAPSULE effectively alleviates the symptoms of various types of neuropathic pain, where Methylcobalamin acts by rejuvenating the damaged neurons by improving the production of myelin and Pregabalin acts by interfering with various pain signals travelling through the damaged nerves and the brain, thus leading to a significant pain relief in various neuropathic pain states.

name: CEREKLAS 60 Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About CEREKLAS 60 INJECTION

CEREKLAS 60 INJECTION contains Cerebroprotein Hydrolysate which belongs to group of medicines called Neurotrophic agents. It is used to manage cranial injury, aprosexia (inability to concentrate) in dementia, cerebrovascular disease that includes stroke, and Alzheimer's disease.

A cranial injury is a head injury causing trauma to the scalp, skull, or brain. It is characterised by symptoms such as leakage of blood outside the blood vessels, uncontrolled bleeding, skull fracture, brain injury, or swelling in the brain.

A stroke occurs when the blood supply to the brain or part of it is blocked. It is characterised by symptoms such as troubled speech, numbness in the body, visual disturbances, headaches, and troubled waking.

Dementia is a group of symptoms such as loss of memory and thinking/reasoning abilities. Alzheimer’s disease is a disorder that causes progressive degeneration of brain cells, resulting in brain shrinkage. It is characterised by dementia, social withdrawal, and wandering.

CEREKLAS 60 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe renal dysfunction, status epilepticus (a life-threatening neurological disorder), or major epilepsia (a seizure that causes loss of consciousness and violent muscle contractions).

CEREKLAS 60 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with epilepsy (fits or seizures) and or allergic diathesis (condition causing predisposition to develop group of allergies such as hay fever, allergic rhinitis, bronchial asthma, or atopic dermatitis).

CEREKLAS 60 INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding females only if it is clearly needed. CEREKLAS 60 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The common side effects associated with the use of CEREKLAS 60 INJECTION are headache, nausea, vertigo (sensation of spinning), increased sweating, agitation, fever, and hallucinations. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage cerebrovascular disease that includes stroke (lack of blood supply in the brain)

CEREKLAS 60 INJECTION helps in restoring brain functions where Cerebroprotein Hydrolysate works by protecting nerve cells from toxins and lack of oxygen. introduction:
Introduction About CITIALFA P 400 TABLET

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking CITIALFA P 400 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CITIALFA P 400 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking CITIALFA P 400 TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITIALFA P 400 TABLET Works

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, CITIALFA P 400 TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use CITIALFA P 400 TABLET

Take CITIALFA P 400 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CITIALFA P 400 TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Your doctor will evaluate the risks and benefits of the therapy and prescribes it to you accordingly. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking CITIALFA P 400 TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of childbearing age must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CITIALFA P 400 TABLET.
CITIALFA P 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience drowsiness or shakiness after taking CITIALFA P 400 TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with CITIALFA P 400 TABLET.

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or ever had any severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CITIALFA P 400 TABLET if you are allergic to Citicoline or Piracetam.

Others

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have a previous history of bleeding in the brain
Have Huntington Disease (a rare genetic disease that causes degeneration of nerve cells)
Have prolonged bleeding within the skull (intracranial hemorrhage)
Have trimethylaminuria (fishy odor in the urine)
Have Parkinson’s disease
Have a previous history of depression

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

CITIALFA P 400 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
